{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|So you want to ask me about Luke's freighter? Hey, no problem. That was one of the first pieces of hardware I've ever worked on.|Gibbon Lightfoot|<ref name="Luke's Freighter">{{WEGCite|story=Luke's Freighter|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Gibbon Lightmoon''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] flight [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] break-away [[720 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] used to hide his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] during Skywalker's [[Mission to Poderis]].<ref name="Luke's Freighter" /> Lightmoon was one of the original designers of the covert shroud [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]/[[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] system.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|254|Lightmoon, Gibbon}}</ref>
